name: Hard Voxelization (Deterministic)
definition: Converts a set of 3D points into a fixed-size voxel grid structure by assigning each point to a discrete voxel based on its coordinates and a specified voxel size and range. It handles duplicate points within the same voxel and limits the number of points per voxel and total voxels.
summary: Hard Voxelization (Deterministic) converts point clouds to voxel grids using stable sorting to guarantee bit-identical output, unlike non-deterministic methods that sacrifice reproducibility for speed.
